question: The inlet of the Bay of Bengal between south - eastern India and northern Sri Lanka is called:
solution: The correct answer is __**Palk Strait**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The Palk Strait is a strait between India and Srilanka. • It connects the Bay of Bengal in the northeast with the Gulf of Mannar in the southwest. • This chain extends between Dhanushkodi on Pamban (Rameswaram) Island in Tamil Nadu and Mannar Island in Sri Lanka.
